46:     if math.hypot(*eps.values()) > epsilon_sig * (1 + 1e-14) or sum(alpha.values()) >= 1:
47:         raise ValueError("ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_COMPLEX_PRECISION_OR_FAILURE_BUDGET")
48:     if evidence_kind not in {"UNKNOWN", "EMPIRICAL", "CERTIFIED"}:

54:     rows = {}

57:         u = None if allowance[a] is None else nonnegative(allowance[a], "allowance")
58:         if evidence_kind == "UNKNOWN":
59:             u = None
60:         h = None if b is None or u is None else eps[a] - b - u
61:         status = ("UNDETERMINED" if h is None else "ELIGIBLE" if h > 0
62:                   else "INELIGIBLE" if max(0., b - u) >= eps[a] else "UNDETERMINED")
63:         n = log_n = None
64:         if status == "ELIGIBLE" and log_B is not None:

66:             if log_n < math.log(2**52):

236: def numerical_evidence(adapter, state, config, plan):
237:     from scipy.sparse.linalg import expm_multiply
238:     full = adapter.operators()[0].toarray()
239:     ref_dense = complex(np.vdot(state, expm(-1j*config.T*full)@state))
240:     ref_sparse = complex(np.vdot(state, expm_multiply(-1j*config.T*adapter.operators()[0], state)))
241:     mean = dense_law_mean(adapter, q=config.q)
242:     corrected = complex(np.vdot(state, mean@state))
243:     raw = complex(np.vdot(state, sparse_mean_action(adapter, state, q=config.q)))
244:     logB = config.q*adapter.log_B_step
245:     discrepancy = abs(raw*math.exp(logB)-corrected)
246:     closure = abs(raw-math.exp(-logB)*corrected)
247:     tol = plan["numerical"]
248:     gates = dict(reference=check(abs(ref_dense-ref_sparse), tol["reference_signal_agreement"], "DENSE_SPARSE_REFERENCE"),
249:                  law_mean=check(discrepancy, tol["law_mean_agreement"], "HORNER_FORWARD_LAW_MEAN"),
250:                  raw_normalization=check(closure, tol["law_mean_agreement"], "RAW_CORRECTED_NORMALIZATION"))
251:     # Existing empirical_allowance formula, with a declared conservative count
252:     # of scalar-operation proxies for these tiny matrix computations.
253:     work = config.q*(2*len(adapter.operators()[1])*len(state)**3 +
254:                      config.r*(config.K+2)*len(state)**3)+len(state)**3
255:     maximum = max(1., float(np.linalg.norm(mean, 2)), float(np.linalg.norm(mean@state)))
256:     s = tol["allowance_settings"]
257:     rounding = s["roundoff_multiplier"]*np.finfo(float).eps*(1+work)*maximum
258:     agreement = abs(ref_dense-ref_sparse)+discrepancy+closure
259:     u = s["safety_factor"]*max(s["floor"], rounding, agreement)
260:     du = s["safety_factor"]*max(s["floor"], rounding, closure)
261:     return dict(gates=gates, corrected=dict(real=corrected.real, imag=corrected.imag),
262:                 reference=dict(real=ref_dense.real, imag=ref_dense.imag),
263:                 allowance=dict(cosine=u, sine=u), log_B_margin=du,
264:                 rounding_proxy=rounding, work=work, maximum_norm=maximum,
265:                 agreement=agreement, certified=False, kind="EMPIRICAL",
266:                 scope="existing allowance formula, declared dense/sparse operation proxy; local diagnostic only")

1469:         finite_taylor_order,

1471:     )

1473:         raise ValueError("finite_taylor_order must be a non-negative even integer.")

1476:         _paired_order_weight(dimensionless_step_time, order) for order in orders

1481:         dimensionless_step_time=float(dimensionless_step_time),
1482:         finite_taylor_order=finite_taylor_order,
1483:         orders=orders,
1484:         unnormalized_order_weights=weights,
